anatomic_site_tumor.evidence: In an analysis of 26 cervical tumors, CD8A and CD4 were detected in all tumors, followed by PD-L1 in 85%, LAG-3 in 65%, PD1 in 50%, and PD-L2 in 35%.

cell_type.evidence: organism parts: Lymph node; T cell

material_type.evidence: Frozen tissue samples were lysed and added to premixed antibody beads.

sample_source.evidence: We developed and validated a sensitive and robust immuno-liquid chromatography-parallel reaction monitoring assay to simultaneously quantify the expression levels of six immune markers (CD8A, CD4, LAG3, PD1, PD-L1, and PD-L2) using as little as 1-2 mg of fresh frozen tissue.
